title: Lake Pleasant Guided Morning Kayak Tour Near Phoenix
includes: Kayak, paddle and US Coast Guard-approved life jacket
Lake Pleasant park entrance fee: $10 per vehicle (not included)
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Start your day on the water with the Arise Series—Into the Light, a relaxed guided morning kayak tour at Lake Pleasant near Phoenix. After a safety briefing and basic paddling instruction, follow your guide across calm water toward scenic coves and mountain views while watching for desert birds and other wildlife. The small-group format keeps the pace comfortable and leaves time for photos. Choose the early departure for sunrise colors or the later departure for a peaceful morning paddle. No previous kayaking experience is required, and your kayak, paddle, and life jacket are provided.
